articles.title: Bitcoin holds steady near $64,000 as monero, hyperliquid outperform
articles.snippet: Crypto markets remain in a low volatility holding pattern, trading in a tight range following Wednesday's CPI report.

articles.title: Bitcoin keeps traders guessing near $64K as stocks gain on cool US PPI data
articles.snippet: Bitcoin joined US stocks in modest gains after July PPI inflation data continued a cooling trend seen over the past month.

articles.title: SEC allows Franklin Templeton funds to invest in onchain money fund
articles.snippet: The SEC said it will not pursue enforcement action if Franklin Templeton’s funds start investing cash in the asset manager’s own tokenized money market fund.

articles.title: Binance bStocks pass xStocks as second-largest tokenized stock issuer
articles.snippet: Binance bStocks became the second-largest tokenized stock issuer less than two months after launch, narrowly ahead of Kraken’s xStocks.

articles.title: Crypto valuations could double as protocols link revenue to tokens: Bitwise CIO
articles.snippet: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan said he expects revenue-capture mechanisms to spread across DeFi applications and layer-1 networks over the next 12 to 24 months.
